circuits.name: Pauli-X Gate
circuits.desc: Quantum NOT — flips |0⟩ ↔ |1⟩.

circuits.name: Pauli-Y Gate
circuits.desc: Bit + phase flip (π rotation about Y).

circuits.name: Pauli-Z Gate
circuits.desc: Phase flip — shown on |+⟩ so the sign is visible.

circuits.name: Hadamard Gate
circuits.desc: Creates superposition: |0⟩ → (|0⟩+|1⟩)/√2.

circuits.name: Phase Gate (S)
circuits.desc: Adds 90° phase to |1⟩. S² = Z.

circuits.name: π/8 Gate (T)
circuits.desc: Adds 45° phase to |1⟩. The "magic" gate for universality.

circuits.name: T† Gate
circuits.desc: Inverse of T — subtracts 45° phase.

circuits.name: S† Gate
circuits.desc: Inverse of S — subtracts 90° phase.

circuits.name: Rx(θ) Rotation
circuits.desc: Rotation about the X-axis (θ = π/2 shown).

circuits.name: Ry(θ) Rotation
circuits.desc: Rotation about the Y-axis (θ = π/2 shown).

circuits.name: Rz(θ) Rotation
circuits.desc: Rotation about the Z-axis (θ = π/2 shown), on |+⟩.

circuits.name: U3(θ,φ,λ) Gate
circuits.desc: General single-qubit unitary as Rz(λ)·Ry(θ)·Rz(φ).

circuits.name: √X Gate
circuits.desc: Square-root of X ≈ Rx(π/2) — halfway between I and X.

circuits.name: √Z Gate
circuits.desc: Square-root of Z — identical to the S gate, on |+⟩.

circuits.name: Identity Gate (I)
circuits.desc: Does nothing — Rz(0), a timing/placeholder gate.

circuits.name: CNOT (CX)
circuits.desc: Flips the target when control = |1⟩. Control set to |1⟩ → |11⟩.

circuits.name: Controlled-Z (CZ)
circuits.desc: Phase-flips when both are |1⟩. Target |+⟩ → |−⟩.

circuits.name: Controlled-Y (CY)
circuits.desc: Applies Y to the target when control = |1⟩.

circuits.name: Controlled-H (CH)
circuits.desc: Applies Hadamard to the target when control = |1⟩.

circuits.name: SWAP Gate
circuits.desc: Exchanges the two qubits: |10⟩ → |01⟩.

circuits.name: Controlled-Phase (CP)
circuits.desc: Controlled phase rotation (λ = π/2), on |1,+⟩.

circuits.name: Toffoli (CCX)
circuits.desc: Flips the target only if both controls are |1⟩ → |111⟩.

circuits.name: Fredkin (CSWAP)
circuits.desc: Swaps two qubits if the control is |1⟩: |1,1,0⟩ → |1,0,1⟩.

circuits.name: Controlled-Controlled-Z (CCZ)
circuits.desc: Phase-flip when both controls are |1⟩. Target |+⟩ → |−⟩.

circuits.name: Peres Gate
circuits.desc: A universal reversible gate: Toffoli followed by CNOT.

circuits.name: |0⟩ Initialization
circuits.desc: Ground state — the default qubit state.

circuits.name: |1⟩ Preparation
circuits.desc: Apply X to |0⟩.

circuits.name: |+⟩ Preparation
circuits.desc: Apply H to |0⟩ — equal superposition.

circuits.name: |−⟩ Preparation
circuits.desc: Apply H to |1⟩ — superposition with a minus phase.

circuits.name: |+i⟩ Preparation
circuits.desc: Apply H then S to |0⟩.

circuits.name: |−i⟩ Preparation
circuits.desc: Apply H then S† to |0⟩.

circuits.name: Bell State
circuits.desc: Maximally entangled pair (|00⟩+|11⟩)/√2.

circuits.name: GHZ State
circuits.desc: (|000⟩+|111⟩)/√2 — all-or-nothing entanglement.

circuits.name: Graph / Cluster State
circuits.desc: H on every qubit, then CZ on each edge of a line.
circuits.savedName: Library · State Preparation · Graph / Cluster State

circuits.name: Magic State |T⟩
circuits.desc: (|0⟩+e^{iπ/4}|1⟩)/√2 — resource for fault-tolerant T gates.

circuits.name: Z-basis Measurement
circuits.desc: Measure a |+⟩ superposition in the computational basis → 50/50.

circuits.name: X-basis Measurement
circuits.desc: Rotate with H then measure — |+⟩ reads out deterministically.

circuits.name: Y-basis Measurement
circuits.desc: S†·H basis change before measuring |+i⟩.

circuits.name: Bell-basis Measurement
circuits.desc: CX·H basis change projects a Bell pair onto the Bell basis.

circuits.name: Parity Measurement
circuits.desc: XOR two data qubits onto an ancilla and measure the parity.

circuits.name: Quantum Fourier Transform (3q)
circuits.desc: Hadamards + controlled phases + a final swap.
circuits.savedName: Library · Interface & Subroutines · Quantum Fourier Transform (3q)

circuits.name: Inverse QFT (3q)
circuits.desc: The QFT run backwards, with negated phases.

circuits.name: Phase Oracle
circuits.desc: Marks |11⟩ with a −1 phase via CZ.

circuits.name: Grover Diffusion Operator
circuits.desc: Reflection about the mean: H·X·CZ·X·H.
circuits.savedName: Library · Interface & Subroutines · Grover Diffusion Operator

circuits.name: Amplitude Amplification (Grover iteration)
circuits.desc: One oracle + one diffusion step — amplifies |11⟩.
circuits.savedName: Library · Interface & Subroutines · Amplitude Amplification (Grover iteration)

circuits.name: Quantum Teleportation
circuits.desc: Bell pair + Bell measurement + X/Z corrections (deferred).

circuits.name: Superdense Coding
circuits.desc: Send 2 classical bits (here "11") over 1 qubit + entanglement.

circuits.name: Swap Test
circuits.desc: Ancilla + controlled-SWAP + H estimates state overlap.

circuits.name: Hadamard Test
circuits.desc: Estimates Re⟨ψ|U|ψ⟩ for U = Z via an ancilla.

circuits.name: Trotter Step (e^{-iθ ZZ})
circuits.desc: One Trotter slice: CNOT · Rz(2θ) · CNOT plus X fields.
circuits.savedName: Library · Interface & Subroutines · Trotter Step (e^{-iθ ZZ})

circuits.name: Controlled-Rotation (CRz)
circuits.desc: Applies Rz(θ) to the target when the control is |1⟩.

circuits.name: Syndrome Extraction (bit-flip code)
circuits.desc: Two ancillas read Z₀Z₁ and Z₁Z₂ parities without touching the data.
circuits.savedName: Library · Interface & Subroutines · Syndrome Extraction (bit-flip code)

circuits.name: Transversal CNOT
circuits.desc: Fault-tolerant CNOT between two 2-qubit code blocks, qubit-wise.
